$comment: Consolidated permission grant for a hands-off run. Generate the real one from your config with `loopsmith permissions <config> --write .claude/settings.local.json` — it derives the narrowest set your loop actually needs instead of asking for everything. This file is the shape, not the answer.

permissions.$deny_note: Nothing is denied here by default. Denial is not the mechanism that protects you — the constraint block in the loop config is, because it stops on irreversible actions regardless of what this file allows.

$sections.core_tools: Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep — the loop reads and writes inside its own directory.
$sections.providers: One Bash rule per provider command declared in the config. Providers you have not configured are omitted; there is no reason to pre-authorise a binary you never call.
$sections.detectors: One Bash rule per script detector, so the gate can run its checks without a prompt mid-run.
$sections.acquisition: Only present when skills.acquisition_order includes `marketplace`. A loop that never reaches the marketplace never asks for network access.

$still_stops: Promoting a quarantined sub-agent out of generated-skills/
